verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud-connected robotics platform with a CLI and an on-device viam-server, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a way to disable usage tracking or product telemetry. The 'telemetry' mentions refer to user-directed sensor data capture, a different feature, and do not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
